_comment: The shared ui-check size presets (CSS px), one set for every app: the Razr's two displays as Chrome apps (read from Property Tycoon's settings page). The default sweep is cover-cams, cover and internal; cover-wide (Property Tycoon) and full are presets an app or a run asks for (--sizes full). type follows the three shared device queries (.shared/README.md "Screen Sizes"): cover = (max-height: 499px); internal = up to 480 wide and 500+ tall; full = 481+ wide and 500+ tall. An app's config.json "sizes" may add presets of its own.

cover-cams.note: Razr cover, Chrome app, page to the bottom edge (cameras bottom-right: buttons in the pocket)

cover.note: Razr cover, Chrome app, page ends above the cameras

cover-wide.note: landscape short screen (Property Tycoon's wide cover)
